label: Observatory circular hall R05 frozen structural candidate, not accepted
limitations: Frozen R05 structural and lighting proxy only, not source or model acceptance. All five real R01-R05 commits, editable material/white BLEND and GLB files, scripts, reports, source evidence and failed trials are preserved verbatim.

Sources are attributed article images rather than native decoded video frames. Precise clip times, highest decodable source quality and later replay checks are unknown. The source cameras remain uncalibrated; visual similarity is not accepted geometry.

Producer corrected a mistaken five-point star to a four-point concave candidate. The full 16-sector/14-window/two-door-pair arrangement is a conditional hypothesis informed by the visible front; rear structure, star scale and recess proportions remain unconfirmed.

R02/R03 wall mapping failures, R03 negative-volume/self-crossing evidence and failed previews remain preserved. R04 Boolean apertures are producer changes, not independently accepted full geometry; finite ray or import checks do not prove full-shell validity.

The rejected planar four-star-tip camera trial is retained under qa/R06-star-fit.json within this R05 freeze. Its reduced residual produced cameras outside the hall and was not applied to models or renders; the filename does not establish a delivered R06 stage.

Three reported Depth Anything V2 relative inverse-depth runs and their failures are preserved. These article-image outputs are not metric or native-source geometry acceptance; mirror floors, effects, dark interiors and background planets remain unreliable.

Complete source-camera render sets, direct overlays, eight-angle image coverage and full geometry regression remain incomplete according to the frozen report. Archive integrity does not upgrade any technical or source claim.

Archive worker only materializes supported input, checks file bytes and Git objects, preserves history, and performs ordinary Git commits/pushes and remote readback. No modeling, rendering, source-script execution, production-worktree changes, credential copying, LFS, force push, main changes, Issues or PRs.
The separately blocked source-screening receipt remains paused and is not retried or included in this observatory publication.
